 ‘Marshals’ Season 2 Episode 4 Recap: Cal Me Maybe  
 Sheridan Sundays are officially back! But if fans of the Yellowstone sequel spin-off, Marshals , tune into CBS expecting to watch a new episode tonight, they may be disappointed…
 It’s been five weeks since we reunited with Kayce (Luke Grimes), Cal (Logan Marshall-Green), Belle (Arielle Kebbel), Andrea (Ash Santos), Miles (Tatanka Means), Rainwater (Gil Birmingham), and the rest of the Marshals crew in Season 2’s premiere on October 4. And after Season 2, Episode 5 ended with such a compelling Kayce and Dre scene, fans were counting down the days until a new episode of Marshals .
 So is Marshals on tonight, Sunday, November 8? When does Marshals return with new episodes on CBS and Paramount+? And what does Marshals Season 2, Episode 6, “Roughstock” have in store?
 Here’s everything to know about Marshals Season 2, Episode 6 premiere date, time, and how to watch live on CBS and online.
 Is Marshals On Tonight (11/8/26) ?
 Sadly, no. There won’t be a new episode of Marshals Season 2 airing Sunday, November 8, 2026 on CBS.
 Why Isn’t Marshals On Tonight (11/8/26)? 
 This week, NFL games aren’t to blame for the Marshals delay. Instead, CBS is giving Marshals and Tracker a week off and airing the last three episodes of their new Silicon Valley-set legal drama, Cupertino . If you haven’t had a chance to check out the new series from Robert and Michelle King, starring Mike Colter, Rachel Keller, Busy Philipps, Ella Stiller, and more, consider this your sign!
 When Does Marshals Return With New Episodes On CBS And Paramount+? Marshals Season 2, Episode 6 Release Date, Time: 
 Marshals Season 2, Episode 6 will air next Sunday, November 15, from 8:00 to 9:00 p.m. ET/PT on CBS, with live and next-day streaming on Paramount+ (Premium).
 See Also 
 ‘Marshals’ Season 2: Ash Santos Teases Dre And Kayce Romances, Jimmy’s Return, A Trip To New York, And More 
 Marshals “Roughstock”: Marshals Season 2, Episode 6 Episode Description 
 The official synopsis for Marshals Episode 206, “Roughstock” is as follows: “With Cal away in Utah seeing a cancer specialist, Andrea steps up as team leader and is instantly tested when Kayce ventures outside Marshals jurisdiction to help Mo track down his missing nephew. Meanwhile, unbeknownst to the rest of the team, Belle accompanies Cal on his trip to Salt Lake City as the two grow closer.”
 How Many Episodes Are In Marshals Season 2? 
 While Marshals Season 1 consisted of 13 episodes, Marshals Season 2 received an even larger 20-episode order!
 When Does Dutton Ranch Season 2 Return? 
 While you’re here, might as well get the latest on Kelly Reilly and Cole Hauser’s Yellowstone spinoff Dutton Ranch , which was also renewed for Season 2 . Sadly, there’s no official  Dutton Ranch  Season 2 premiere date on the books yet. That said,  The Hollywood Reporter confirmed  that “production [is] slated to begin early 2027.”
 “We’re slated to start early 2027 to film,” Reilly told  THR  in July. “But the room starts up pretty quick. I think we’re going to be very much involved in the room, so the next sort of six months is all about writing it.”
 Assuming production sticks to the predicted timeline, here’s hoping  Dutton Ranch  Season 2 will premiere in 2027. Stay tuned for more updates!
 Where To Watch Marshals : Paramount+ Streaming Info: 
 Want to catch up on or rewatch Marshals while you wait for new episodes? Here’s how to stream Marshals Season 1 and new Season 2 episodes…
 Paramount+ offers two subscription plans, Essential and Premium. Right now, you can get started with a seven-day free trial on the Premium plan.
 The ad-supported Essential plan typically costs $8.99/month, while the ad-free Premium plan (which comes with Showtime titles and live CBS) costs $13.99/month.
